description: This file contains unit tests for the AdoNetQueueAdapter class, specifically testing its behavior against different SQL databases like SQL Server, MySQL, and PostgreSQL. It includes tests for construction, enqueuing messages, and receiver functionality, targeting the Orleans streaming implementation with ADO.NET storage.
